title: The Moles' Intergalactic Snack Run
summary: Two adventurous moles named Disco and Disco discover a hidden red button while digging beneath a garden. Pressing it launches them into space aboard a shiny metal rocket ship stocked with 'Zingos'—a delicious snack of worms and ants. Guided by Captain Izzy, the crew navigates to the planet Sauthica to deliver life-saving sandwiches to the tiny, starving Mookers. After a quick visit to the Odic Aquarium to see a giant Angler fish, the brave explorers return safely to Earth just in time for bed.

characters.name: Disco
characters.description: An energetic Mischief Mole and superhero-clad detective, Disco is one of two identical twins who embark on grand adventures through the deep. Alongside her sister Thisco, this architect of the subterranean maps hidden realms—from frozen frontiers to the dusty canyons beneath the furniture—by piloting her signature submarine or racing toy cars through the bedroom's wild heights. Guided by "Cornebyborn" dances and Papa Mole’s lore, she finds solace within her glowing basket house, a dream sanctuary and fortress of a hundred locks. Whether navigating grimy domestic landscapes or open waters, Disco balances mechanical ingenuity with a persistent, soft-hearted wonder for the night sky.

characters.name: Second Disco
characters.description: Another mole character named Disco who assists in digging and sweeping.

characters.name: Isabella
characters.description: A towering Dimitar scholar and alchemist of Atsukeeseet, Mama Izzy is a clever kiddo at heart and a steadfast guardian of rooftop gardens and intricate dollhouses. Gifted with the power of flight, she navigates the open heights with aquatic grace, her massive frame often shielded by a special protective metal that glimmers even as she descends into the shadows. As a resourceful quartermaster, she employs red flashlights, gold-laced slimes, and pipe cleaners to mend a Lanternshark’s failing light, yet her generosity remains her hallmark; she freely shares her vast library, brokers homes for dragons, and teaches others to find the resonance in their own voices. Her most profound magic resides in her vast, soft blanket—a sanctuary of ultimate coziness—where she remains a brave, quick-witted protector to all who honor her singular request for absolute silence.

characters.name: The Mookers
characters.description: Hailing from a neighboring planet, these toe-sized spheres of dense fur bear the uncanny features of miniature moose. They communicate through a rhythmic chorus of "mooks" and are defined by a singular, voracious obsession with sandwiches.

characters.name: Angler
characters.description: A giant fish seen at the Odic Aquarium.

places.name: Underground Tunnel
places.description: Tucked behind Goober the Gopher’s overstuffed armchair and a bookshelf of weathered lore lies a yawning, meticulously carved excavation. This plunging vertical shaft—the very site where industrious moles labored until their claws struck the cold hull of a buried rocket—spirals downward from the cozy retreat as a gateway into a vast and echoing subterranean world.

places.name: Space Rocket
places.description: A shiny metal vessel buried under the garden.

places.name: Sauthica
places.description: The planet of the Mookers, located just a few streets away from the garden.

places.name: Cornell Street
places.description: Bisected by a stark yellow line, this celestial artery cuts through a dense forest to chart a path toward the Mookers' planet. A cosmic thoroughfare where the infinite is stitched into the earthly, it anchors local commerce—typified by a towering tree of honey—alongside the residence of Uncle X, the house of the surreal bedroom feast, and Hattie’s home. It remains the vital threshold where the mundane pulse of the woods meets the stars, marking the point where Hattie begins her journey to find medical help.

places.name: Odic Aquarium
places.description: A planetary destination filled with exotic fish.

places.name: Planet Earth
places.description: The home planet where the garden and the moles' house are located.
